thread:
michelle_cust: Hi team — we're seeing intermittent 401s and also the response body from JSON mode is sometimes invalid JSON. Happened on two calls from our prod worker. Sample response attached below.

jason_support: sorry to hear that, can you paste the raw response body and the request headers (no API key) + timestamp? also did you rotate keys recently?

michelle_cust: pasted. Request ts=2026-03-01T14:12:09Z
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"choices":[{"message":{"content":{"type":"json", "value":"{\"user\":\"alice\", \"note\":\"Line1\\nLine2\\\"quote\\\"end\"}"}}}], "usage":{...}}
```

michelle_cust: sometimes the chunk ends inside the quoted string and client parser throws. Also at 14:13 we got a 401 for the same API key, then recovered. Billing shows two small spikes around those times.

jason_support: thanks. two separate problems possible: 1) streaming/chunk boundary escaping causing malformed JSON if client concatenation is broken; 2) transient auth failure (401) — could be token service hiccup or regional failover. I'll triage. Can you confirm: are you using streaming SSE or single response?

michelle_cust: streaming SSE via our Node worker (axios + eventsource polyfill). libs: node 18.16, eventsource 2.0.

alex_eng: pinging infra/runtime. The payload in the sample shows backslashes and newline escapes inside a JSON string. If a stream cuts mid-escape (e.g. "\\" preceding a quote), a naive concat can produce unescaped sequences. We intentionally emit atomic JSON chunks but older clients may reassemble incorrectly. Do you have the exact sequence of SSE data events (raw chunks)?

michelle_cust: i captured SSE chunks, here they are (raw lines):
```
data: {"choices":[{"message":{"content":{"type":"json","value":"{\"user\":\"alice\", \"note\":\"Line1\\n
" 

data: "Line2\\\"end\""}}}], "done":false}
data: [DONE]
```

michelle_cust: so you can see chunk boundary splits a backslash-newline escape and then later the escaped quote becomes `\\\"` sequence weirdness. Parser on our end fails to recover some times.

jason_support: that helps. two immediate asks: 1) try a non-streaming (single) call to confirm server-side JSON is valid end-to-end; 2) share the request id and region from response headers when you saw the 401 so we can correlate. Also, I'll escalate to billing for the spike.

sara_billing: i pulled preliminary billing for that org and saw two meter events at 14:12:10 and 14:13:02 with small token counts, then a retry charge at 14:13:05. looks like client retried after 401. i'll hold off until we confirm root cause but will flag potential duplicate charges.

alex_eng: internal note: runtime emits JSON-mode values as single logical objects but over SSE the framing is JSON-encoded as text. If client concatenation isn't performed atomically, escapes at chunk boundaries can be corrupted. We added additional guidance in the streaming docs last year but need to: a) include an example robust reassembly snippet for Node SSE; b) consider adding a boundary-safe encoding option (base64 payload) in case clients can't reassemble reliably.

michelle_cust: workaround for us is to buffer events until a terminating `\\n\\n` or [DONE], then JSON.parse. That reduces throughput but stops failures. Can you patch or recommend a safe reassembly?

jason_support: recommended quick fix: in Node, don't rely on EventSource's event data concatenation — accumulate `data:` lines into a buffer and detect `[DONE]`. Example pseudocode we sent: `let buf=''; onmessage=(e)=>{ if (e.data==='[DONE]'){ process(JSON.parse(buf)); buf=''; } else { buf+=e.data.replace(/^data: /,''); } }` — will send as a snippet in a follow-up.

alex_eng: follow-up from runtime: i opened an internal ticket (RT-4983) to add a Content-Length-like safe chunk marker to JSON streaming and to include an opt-in base64 payload mode. Not scheduled yet. For the 401s: we saw a very short-lived auth-service failover in region eu-west-1 at 14:13:01 causing <30s of 401s; keys themselves were fine. We'll provide incident id once available.

michelle_cust: appreciated. please also confirm there won't be duplicate billing for automatic retries.

sara_billing: we'll await final incident link. if retries are automatic due to server 401 we can issue credits for duplicate meter events — tag this thread when you have the incident id.

jason_support: leaving this open; next steps: michelle to test non-stream call and try buffered SSE assembly; alex to post internal incident id and proposed doc snippet; sara to hold billing review pending incident. I'll follow up in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
